wnba.Headline: Pebley out as Sparks GM, assistants to share interim role
wnba.Description: Raegan Pebley is out after two and a half years as the Sparks' general manager, the team announced Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Mercury lose by 48 in third-biggest blowout in WNBA history
wnba.Description: Mercury coach Nate Tibbetts said his team "can't have any more of these" after Saturday night's 48-point loss to the Aces, the third-worst blowout in WNBA history.

wnba.Headline: Minnesota plays Phoenix after McBride's 25-point outing
wnba.Description: Phoenix Mercury (8-16, 5-9 Western Conference) at Minnesota Lynx (17-6, 10-1 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Las Vegas hosts Indiana following Mitchell's 29-point performance
wnba.Description: Indiana Fever (13-9, 5-4 Eastern Conference) at Las Vegas Aces (17-6, 12-4 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Toronto hosts New York following Mabrey's 34-point game
wnba.Description: New York Liberty (13-10, 8-1 Eastern Conference) at Toronto Tempo (9-13, 4-6 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Ogwumike leads Los Angeles against Atlanta after 25-point outing
wnba.Description: Los Angeles Sparks (10-11, 5-6 Western Conference) at Atlanta Dream (13-10, 7-3 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Aces beat Mercury 106-58 to match the third-biggest win in WNBA history
wnba.Description: — A'ja Wilson had 21 points and 15 rebounds in just 25 minutes as the Las Vegas Aces routed the Phoenix Mercury 106-58 on Saturday night in one of the worst blowouts in WNBA history.

wnba.Headline: Las Vegas Aces vs. Phoenix Mercury - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Las Vegas Aces vs. Phoenix Mercury, 07/11/2026

wnba.Headline: Fire put 7 in double figures in 102-92 win over Dream, who play without injured Reese
wnba.Description: — Megan Gustafson scored 17 points, two others had double-doubles and the Portland Fire held off the Atlanta Dream, who were without All-Star Angel Reese, 102-92 on Saturday.

wnba.Headline: Atlanta Dream vs. Fire - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Atlanta Dream vs. Fire, 07/11/2026

wnba.Headline: McBride scores 25, Miles 23 to lead Lynx to 90-85 win over Liberty
wnba.Description: — Kayla McBride scored 14 of her 25 points in the fourth quarter, Olivia Miles added 23 points after missing two games and the Minnesota Lynx edged the New York Liberty 90-85 on Saturday.

wnba.Headline: Minnesota Lynx vs. New York Liberty - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Minnesota Lynx vs. New York Liberty, 07/11/2026

wnba.Headline: Injured Napheesa Collier (ankles) nearing return for Lynx
wnba.Description: All-Star Napheesa Collier's return could be imminent for a Lynx team that entered the weekend tied atop the WNBA standings with the Las Vegas Aces, coach Cheryl Reeve said.

wnba.Headline: Dallas faces Chicago following Bueckers' 34-point showing
wnba.Description: Chicago Sky (7-15, 1-7 Eastern Conference) at Dallas Wings (15-8, 6-6 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Seattle takes on Washington after Hiedeman's 20-point outing
wnba.Description: Seattle Storm (6-18, 1-12 Western Conference) at Washington Mystics (10-10, 7-5 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Los Angeles Sparks vs. Chicago Sky - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Los Angeles Sparks vs. Chicago Sky, 07/10/2026

wnba.Headline: Nneka Ogwumike has a double-double to lead the Sparks past the Sky, 102-87
wnba.Description: — Nneka Ogwumike had 25 points, 12 rebounds and five assists, Erica Wheeler added 15 points and eight assists, and the Los Angeles Sparks beat the Chicago Sky 102-87 on Friday night.

wnba.Headline: Valkyries beat the Sun 79-64 for a franchise-record 7th straight win
wnba.Description: — Veronica Burton scored 17 points, Janelle Salaun had 16 points and four 3-pointers off the bench, and the Golden State Valkyries beat the Connecticut Sun 79-64 on Friday night for a franchise-record seventh straight victory.

wnba.Headline: WNBA regular-season record crowd of 20,996 watch Wings beat Tempo
wnba.Description: Paige Bueckers scored 34 points and Dallas beat expansion Toronto 108-95 on Friday night in front of a WNBA regular-season record crowd of 20,996 at Bell Centre.
